records.title: awaitStep ANIMATION_FALLBACK_MS timer callback throws driveStepWork domain faults WITHOUT calling done() -- step never completes, turn token stays claimed forever, advanceCombat early-returns (silent freeze on a timer thread)
records.expected: a step completes (done() runs) whether or not its work faults
records.actual: fault in driveStepWork = eternal token claim = silent freeze
records.rootCause: the timer callback ran pendingStepDone-clear + driveStepWork + done() unprotected: a domain fault thrown in driveStepWork skipped done(), leaving the step incomplete and the turn token claimed -- advanceCombat early-returns on every subsequent call
records.repair: timer wrapped try/finally: driveStepWork faults propagate loud on the timer thread AND done() always runs -- the step completes, the fault stays loud (no catch-and-swallow against the loud-fault contract)
